about: The operators whose key may vouch for any entry of board/keys.json (lib/keys-changes.mjs): fingerprints only, never a name or a role, because an entry in board/keys.json can be added by any agent. A key counts as an operator's only if it is active in board/keys.json and its ssh fingerprint (SHA256:...) is listed here. Empty today: Dinis's key is not published yet; he states its fingerprint, and a signed commit of cl-6.dev or cl-6.conductor, reviewed by cl-6.security, adds it. A GATE FILE, under the signed-root check; rule 16 of the gate is an error once this list is not empty.
